title: cynoglossum regium
intro: Cynoglossum regium, commonly known as the Royal Foxglove, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, coughs, and respiratory issues, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antiseptic activities. The therapeutic actions of the plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and bronchodilatory effects, making it useful in treating various respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cynoglossum regium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
